series_title: The Ancient World of Ice and Fire
episode_title: Before the Dragons: The Rise of Old Valyria
visual_cadence_rule: 30 images per minute (1 image every 2.0 seconds)
visual_qc_note: All ten frames passed visual review, are 1376x768 sRGB PNGs, are uploaded to Drive folder 1XqRVZAcPjVjPK7EjcQaYLWCxE4yvfYTF, and each Drive MD5 matches its local file; Drive lists exactly ten images. Eight passed first time; IMG0303 and IMG0310 were letterboxed and IMG0307 had a hairline strip, all reframed to full-bleed before review. IMG0303 and IMG0309 were held for rerender: the elder drifted bald-crowned and long-coated for the third consecutive batch, and IMG0309 then took four attempts (bald crown, then long cloak with a floating artifact, then a snow-reading pale ground crust, then a row of identical hooded silhouettes). Director's boundaries held across all ten: no dragon, dragon silhouette or reptile anywhere, since DRG-VAL-001 is introduced at IMG0316; no bones, skulls or corpses, since the charred-remains line lands at IMG0311-0315; and the chamber reads as raw chaotic geology rather than built architecture. Standing flags: the elder's baldness and long-coat drift is unresolved after three batches and must be checked at 300% on every frame he appears in; small orange vent glints in IMG0305 and IMG0308 read as scattered firelight and must not become a visible lava source; the lowland pasture in IMG0304 is sunnier than the Batches 028-030 palette and must not brighten further; and pale ash crust on black ground must never be rendered light enough to read as snow, which is how IMG0309 failed one pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Low-angle monumental architectural / geological framing — High basalt pillars & charred bones fused into black glass
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass. The shattered wall of leaning columns with one tall pillar reads as raw geology, deliberately chaotic rather than a colonnade. Herdsman small and low with his back to camera, pale hair and spear on model.

scenes.visual_beat: Over-the-shoulder depth perspective — High basalt pillars & charred bones fused into black glass
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass. OTS with the elder's sheepskin shoulder and crook soft in the near foreground; the boy alone at the base of the tallest column. No baldness visible at this crop because only the ear and temple show.

scenes.visual_beat: Deep-focus wide atmospheric composition — High basalt pillars & charred bones fused into black glass
scenes.qc_note: Approved on the rerender. The first pass gave both foreground figures a bald pink crown and ankle-length cloaks; the approved frame shows three figures from behind on the cracked black-glass floor, every head fully haired, and the elder's cloak ending above his boot tops with trousers and boots visible.

scenes.visual_beat: Ultra-wide establishing vista — High basalt pillars & charred bones fused into black glass
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass, with a flag: the green lowlands are lush and sunlit compared with the palette of Batches 028-030, and the sea reads as a lake at this angle. Accepted because the contrast is the point of the shot — but Batch 032 must not let the pasture drift sunnier than this.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium close-up atmospheric focal beat — High basalt pillars & charred bones fused into black glass
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass. Strict side profile with the gaze lifted up and away: no eye to camera. Hair reads cool pale silver-gold (#EFE8D8) and only a single narrow temple braid is visible — within lock. Flag: two small orange glints sit in the deep background bokeh (a vent's warm reflection); they read as scattered firelight at this blur and must not become a visible lava source.

scenes.visual_beat: Dynamic medium lateral tracking angle — High basalt pillars & charred bones fused into black glass
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass. Both men mid-stride at three-quarter rear, elder bareheaded with a full head of hair and a knee-length cloak, trousers and boots visible below the hem; sulphur seams give the only warm light.

scenes.visual_beat: Compressed telephoto dramatic subject framing — High basalt pillars & charred bones fused into black glass
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass, reframed from a 1376x744 image area to full-bleed to strip 12 px letterbox bars. Rear view cropped at the shoulders so no face reads; faceted columns stack flat under the 65mm compression. Flag: the shaft beside him reads as a plain spear and the tip sits below frame, so the bronze reads weak — acceptable, since the weapon is not the subject.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium cinematic subject focus — High basalt pillars & charred bones fused into black glass
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass with two flags. The sulphur fissure reads as yellow crystalline crust with steam, which is correct, but small orange embers sit in the middle distance and must not multiply. The hair is silver-gold with two thin temple braids and no scalp plait; the face is angled down and away so no eye reads.

scenes.visual_beat: Wide environmental storytelling tableau — High basalt pillars & charred bones fused into black glass
scenes.qc_note: Approved on the fourth attempt. Pass 1 had the elder bald-crowned with an ankle-length cloak; pass 2 fixed the head but kept the long cloak and added a floating pale blade artifact, bright blonde drift and near-black garments; pass 3 replaced blonde and black but rendered the ground as a pale grey crust that read as snow, then turned the whole group into a row of identical hooded silhouettes. The approved frame scatters five figures at different distances and heights, each in a different posture, heads turned away, hair cool silver-white, garments short and varied, and the ground pure matte black basalt.

scenes.visual_beat: High-elevation geographic / scale reveal — High basalt pillars & charred bones fused into black glass
scenes.qc_note: Approved first pass, reframed from a 1376x744 image area to full-bleed. The caldera reads as a black scar with column teeth along the rim and a long steam plume; two figures as specks on the near rim; green terraces and sea beyond. No buildings, roads or field grid.
